miswired.label: The greater acid bolt that never counted
miswired.explanation: A mage wears a ring carrying the ACID_BOLT3 activation and faces a kobold. The ACID_BOLT3 maneuver looks up the ACID_BOLT2 activation id, so the item is never considered: the maneuver is valued at zero. The correction looks up the id the maneuver describes, and the ring is valued like the correctly-wired lesser bolt in the control.

control.label: Control: the correctly-wired lesser bolt
control.explanation: The same mage wears a ring carrying the ACID_BOLT2 activation, whose maneuver is wired correctly. It is valued identically before and after the correction, and the complete log is byte-identical: the fix changes only the miswired lookups.
